title_zh: Aptos（APT）四年归属期结束，月度释放削减约六成
title_en: Aptos (APT) four-year vesting ends; monthly releases cut ~60%
desc_zh: 早期支持者与核心贡献者归属结束，月度计划释放由约 1131 万枚降至约 454 万枚，后续仅流向社区与基金会池至 2032 年；基金会另承诺永久质押 2.1 亿枚 APT。
desc_en: Vesting for early backers and core contributors ends; planned monthly releases fall from ~11.31M to ~4.54M APT, with future releases only to community/foundation pools through 2032. The foundation has also committed to permanently staking 210M APT.

First 10M Linkers reward claim window closes October 12, 2026. Restricted to registered early users; claiming requires a connected wallet and conditions such as KYC/ITLG holdings. Not a public airdrop.
desc_zh: 首批 1000 万 Linkers 奖励申领通道 10 月 12 日关闭。仅限已注册的早期用户，需连接钱包并满足 KYC/ITLG 持仓等条件；非公开普遍空投。
title_en: InterLink Labs first-round reward claim deadline
title_zh: InterLink Labs 首轮奖励领取截止

desc_en: Released 8:30 AM ET. CPI shapes Fed rate-cut expectations; crypto volatility often spikes around the print.
desc_zh: 北京时间 20:30 发布。通胀数据直接影响美联储降息预期，发布前后加密市场波动常加剧。
title_zh: 美国 9 月 CPI 发布

desc_zh: 据报道 Filecoin 长达六年的代币归属计划将于 10 月 15 日前后结束，大量早期分配进入完全流通状态；具体释放节奏以官方说明为准，解锁不等于抛售。
desc_en: Filecoin's six-year vesting schedule is reported to end around Oct 15, moving large early allocations into full circulation. Unlocks don't equal sells — confirm pacing with official sources.

title_zh: Pantera 区块链峰会（旧金山）
desc_zh: 加密风投 Pantera 在旧金山举办的年度峰会，项目方常借机发布融资与产品消息，会后留意相关公告。
desc_en: Pantera's annual summit in San Francisco — a venue where projects often drop funding and product news; watch for announcements around it.
Claim window for Season 1 / Season 2 allocations closes. Eligible users must claim on-chain before the deadline with a small gas balance ready; unclaimed allocations are forfeited.
desc_zh: Season 1 / Season 2 空投申领通道关闭。已获得分配的用户需在截止前完成链上领取并准备少量 gas 费，逾期未领视为放弃。
约 1.27 亿枚 STRK 解锁。STRK 10 月 11 日单日大涨约六成，解锁与获利了结可能同周叠加，波动风险高。
desc_en: Around 127M STRK unlock. STRK surged ~60% on Oct 11, so unlock supply and profit-taking could collide in the same week — expect elevated volatility.

title_zh: 美国9月PPI与零售销售发布
title_en: US September PPI and retail sales
desc_zh: 北京时间今晚20:30（美东8:30）发布。CPI爆表后市场紧盯PPI是否同样超预期，零售销售检验消费韧性，两者共同左右10月28日加息押注。
desc_en: Released 8:30 AM ET. After the hot CPI, markets watch whether PPI also beats; retail sales test consumer resilience. Both feed into Oct 28 hike bets.
Around 139M ARB unlock (~$29.2M). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is common — holders should stay cautious.
desc_zh: 约 1.39 亿枚 ARB 解锁，价值约 2920 万美元。解锁不等于抛售，但短期可能带来波动，持仓者注意风险。
Deribit 数据显示约 12.5 亿美元 BTC 期权与约 2.475 亿美元 ETH 期权到期；到期前后价格常围绕最大痛点波动，短线注意波动。
desc_en: Roughly $1.25B in BTC and $247.5M in ETH options expire on Deribit; prices often gravitate toward max-pain levels around expiry — expect short-term volatility.

Claims open at 12:00 UTC (20:00 Beijing time) on October 16, 2026. Only for existing Concrete Earn Vault users, sized by recorded Vault position value; connect wallet on the official claim portal and beware of fake sites.
desc_zh: 北京时间 10 月 16 日 20:00（UTC 12:00）开放领取。仅限 Concrete Earn Vault 的现有用户，按其 Vault 持仓价值发放；需连接钱包在官方领取页操作，谨防假冒网站。
title_en: Concrete (CT) Earn Vault users' USDC allocation claim opens
title_zh: Concrete（CT）Earn Vault 用户 USDC 奖励开放领取
欧元区 9 月通胀数据发布
desc_zh: 欧元区 9 月 CPI 公布；若通胀超预期，可能强化全球主要央行的紧缩预期，联动影响风险资产情绪。
desc_en: Eurozone September CPI lands; a hot print could reinforce hawkish expectations at major central banks and spill into risk-asset sentiment.

title_zh: 新加坡金管局稳定币咨询意见征集截止
desc_zh: 新加坡金融管理局稳定币支付监管提案的公众咨询今日截止，涉及全国性支付监管规则变化；留意后续正式监管指引，对稳定币支付格局有直接影响。
desc_en: Singapore's MAS stablecoin consultation on proposed nationwide payment-regulation changes closes today; watch for the final guidance, which directly affects the stablecoin payments landscape.

title_zh: 泰国比特币/以太坊 ETF 框架生效
title_en: Thailand Bitcoin/Ether ETF framework takes effect
desc_zh: 泰国证监会加密 ETF 框架生效，初期仅 BTC、ETH 产品可在泰国证交所上市；10-16 为规则生效日，具体基金仍需逐只获批。
desc_en: Thailand's SEC crypto ETF framework takes effect; initially only BTC and ETH products may list on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Oct 16 is the framework date — individual funds still need approval.

desc_zh: 约 11.7 亿枚 CRO 解锁，占流通量约 2.33%，价值约 7300 万美元（价格快照相关）；解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~1.17B CRO unlock (~2.33% of circulating supply, ~$73M at snapshot prices). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 以太坊社区大会在吉隆坡举行，Glamsterdam主网时间表可能进一步明确；会议期间留意以太坊生态相关公告。
desc_en: Ethereum community conference in Kuala Lumpur; Glamsterdam mainnet timing could get clearer. Watch for ecosystem announcements around it.

desc_zh: 一次性释放约 6.18 亿枚 DBR（约 1170–1250 万美元），约占流通量 10%，是本周规模最大的相对释放；其中约 40% 分配给核心贡献者与战略合作伙伴。
desc_en: ~618M DBR (~$11.7–12.5M, ~10% of circulating supply) unlocked in one cliff — the week's largest relative release; ~40% allocated to core contributors and strategic partners.

desc_zh: 全球支付与金融科技大会在拉斯维加斯举行，传统金融科技公司与加密支付议题的交汇点；会期留意加密支付、稳定币与代币化相关的机构公告。
desc_en: Global payments and fintech conference in Las Vegas — a meeting point of TradFi and crypto-payments themes; watch for institutional announcements on crypto payments, stablecoins and tokenization.
Around $45M of ZRO unlocks (Tokenomist calendar data). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.
desc_zh: 约 4500 万美元 ZRO 解锁（按 Tokenomist 日历数据）。解锁不等于抛售，但需留意短期波动。
按部分市场日历数据，约 5300 万美元 GRAM 解锁。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~$53M GRAM unlock per some market calendars. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

title_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 在 Hoodi 测试网激活
title_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on the Hoodi testnet
desc_zh: UTC 时间 10 月 26 日 17:42（北京时间 10 月 27 日 01:42）在 epoch 132352 激活，引入 ePBS（协议内提议者-构建者分离）与区块级访问列表，是 12 月主网升级前的最后一轮测试；ETH 持有者无需操作。
desc_en: Activates Oct 26 at 17:42 UTC (epoch 132352) with enshrined proposer-builder separation and block-level access lists — the final test round before the December mainnet target. ETH holders need take no action.
Decision at 2:00 PM ET with press conference. Markets watch whether another 2026 hike is coming.
desc_zh: 北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 2:00 公布决议并召开记者会。市场关注年内是否还有加息。
title_zh: 美联储 FOMC 利率决议

desc_en: Around 181M GRASS unlock — 72.4% of circulating supply (~$80M). Extremely high ratio with heavy potential sell pressure. Exercise caution.
desc_zh: 约 1.81 亿枚 GRASS 解锁，占流通量 72.4%，价值约 8000 万美元。比例极高，潜在抛压大，务必谨慎。
北京时间10月28日22:00，约5347万枚JUP解锁，价值约2300万美元，占流通量约1.72%。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~53.47M JUP unlock (~$23M, ~1.72% of supply). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 北京时间10月28日18:00，约2.9亿枚SIGN解锁，价值约1210万美元，占流通量约21.48%，比例较高，潜在抛压需警惕。
desc_en: ~290M SIGN unlock (~$12.1M, ~21.48% of supply) — a high ratio; watch for potential sell pressure.

desc_zh: 去中心化云游戏项目 YOM 在 peaq 网络举行 TGE（欧洲中部时间中午），11 月 17 日开放交易并同步空投（4 月锁仓用户）及 NANO 设备开售。
desc_en: Decentralized cloud-gaming project YOM holds its TGE on peaq (noon CET); trading starts Nov 17, with a matched airdrop for April lock-up participants and NANO device sales on the same day.

title_zh: 美国三季度GDP初值与9月PCE发布
title_en: US Q3 GDP advance estimate and September PCE
desc_zh: 三季度 GDP 初值与美联储最看重的通胀指标 PCE 同日发布，直接影响 10 月 28 日 FOMC 后对年底加息的押注；数据超预期或强化紧缩预期。
desc_en: Q3 GDP advance and the Fed's preferred inflation gauge PCE land on the same day, shaping year-end hike bets after the Oct 28 FOMC. Hot prints would reinforce tightening expectations.

desc_zh: 北京时间10月30日20:00，约2.29亿枚KMNO解锁，价值约1420万美元，占流通量约5.99%。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~229M KMNO unlock (~$14.2M, ~5.99% of supply). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 北京时间10月30日8:00，约1.67亿枚ZORA解锁，价值约1590万美元，占流通量约4.55%。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~167M ZORA unlock (~$15.9M, ~4.55% of supply). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 北京时间10月31日8:00，约1330万美元IMX解锁（按Token Unlocks数据）。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~$13.3M IMX unlock (per Token Unlocks data). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 北京时间10月31日8:00，约1420万美元OP解锁（按Token Unlocks数据）。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~$14.2M OP unlock (per Token Unlocks data). Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

Claim window closes October 31, 2026 (six months after mainnet launch). Only for testnet participants, "Stake Before the Stake" contributors, eligible Discord role holders and OKX Wallet campaign users; unclaimed PROS returns to the community reserve. Verify the official portal claim.pharos.xyz before connecting a wallet and claim early.
desc_zh: 10 月 31 日申领截止（主网上线六个月后关闭）。仅限测试网参与者、"Stake Before the Stake" 贡献者、符合资格的 Discord 角色持有者与 OKX 钱包活动用户；逾期未领将退回社区储备。连接钱包前务必核验官方门户 claim.pharos.xyz，谨防钓鱼，并尽量提前领取。

desc_en: Around 36.82M EIGEN unlock (12.1% of supply, ~$41.6M). May weigh on DeFi sector sentiment.
desc_zh: 约 3682 万枚 EIGEN 解锁，占供应量 12.1%，价值约 4160 万美元，可能影响 DeFi 板块情绪。
北京时间11月1日8:00，约4396万枚SUI解锁，价值约1.13亿美元，占流通量约1.21%，为下周规模最大的单笔解锁之一。
desc_en: ~43.96M SUI unlock (~$113M, ~1.21% of supply) — one of next week's largest single unlocks.

desc_zh: ACE 向早期投资者一次性解锁（具体数量见 Tokenomist 日历）；项目已更名 Endurance，数据源仍为 Tokenomist ACE 页面。
desc_en: ACE cliff unlock to Early Investors (amount per Tokenomist schedule); project rebranded as Endurance.

Ethereum Foundation's developer conference Devcon 8 runs Nov 3–6 at JIO World Centre, Mumbai — the first Devcon in India. Key venue for roadmap (Glamsterdam) and ecosystem announcements; watch related project news around the event.
desc_zh: 以太坊基金会开发者大会 Devcon 8 于 11 月 3–6 日在印度孟买 JIO World Centre 举行——首次在印度举办。是以太坊路线图（Glamsterdam）与生态重要公告的关键场合，开幕前后留意相关项目动态。

title_zh: 2026 阿姆斯特丹比特币大会
desc_zh: BTC Inc 主办的第 5 届欧洲比特币大会，11 月 5–6 日在阿姆斯特丹 SugarFactory 举行，预计 5000+ 与会者，主题含闪电网络、矿业与企业储备。
desc_en: 5th-edition European Bitcoin conference by BTC Inc, Nov 5–6 at SugarFactory, Amsterdam; 5,000+ expected; topics include Lightning, mining and corporate reserves.

desc_zh: MOVE 向早期支持者一次性解锁（cliff 机制）；当前流通约 46.6%，FDV 约 8690 万美元。
desc_en: MOVE cliff unlock to Early Backers; currently ~46.6% of supply unlocked, FDV ~$86.9M.
Released 8:30 AM ET. Hotter-than-expected inflation pressures risk assets.
desc_zh: 北京时间 21:30 发布（冬令时）。若通胀超预期，风险资产承压。
title_zh: 美国 10 月 CPI 发布

desc_en: Around 40.25M LAYER unlock (~$2.8M). Relatively small in size.
desc_zh: 约 4025 万枚 LAYER 解锁，价值约 280 万美元，规模相对较小。

title_en: YOM ($YOM) trading opens with matched airdrop
desc_zh: 10 月 28 日 TGE 后，$YOM 于 11 月 17 日开放交易，并向 4 月锁仓参与者同步发放空投；同日 NANO 设备开售。按官方渠道操作，谨防钓鱼网站。
desc_en: After the Oct 28 TGE, $YOM starts trading on Nov 17 with a matched airdrop for April lock-up participants; NANO device sales open the same day. Use official channels only.
Released 2:00 PM ET. Reveals internal debate on the rate path.
desc_zh: 北京时间 11 月 19 日凌晨 3:00 公布，透露官员对利率路径的分歧。
title_zh: 美联储 10 月会议纪要

desc_en: Official listing on Nov 21; final snapshot Nov 11, wMNEMO must be claimed by Nov 10, wallet registration Nov 12–17. Follow the official timeline.
desc_zh: 官方确认 11 月 21 日上线；11 月 11 日最终快照，wMNEMO 需在 11 月 10 日前领取，钱包注册窗口为 11 月 12–17 日。参与者请按官方时间表操作。

desc_en: Around 16.61B MON unlock (~$450M) — the largest single unlock of the month. Market impact worth watching closely.
desc_zh: 约 166 亿枚 MON 解锁，价值约 4.5 亿美元，是本月最大单笔解锁事件，市场影响值得密切关注。

desc_en: Leaked registration page shows Nov 24 as the sign-up deadline, with TGE possibly late Nov–early Dec. Note: from a leak, not an official announcement — rely on official channels and beware of phishing sites.
desc_zh: 网传注册页面显示 11 月 24 日为报名截止，TGE 可能在 11 月底至 12 月初。注意：该消息来自泄露页面，非官方正式公告，请以官方渠道为准，谨防钓鱼网站。

desc_en: Final 2026 meeting with dot plot. Sets the tone for 2027 policy.
desc_zh: 年内最后一次议息，附点阵图。2026 年政策方向一锤定音。

desc_en: Released 8:30 AM ET. The last inflation print of the year.
desc_zh: 北京时间 21:30 发布，年末最后一份通胀成绩单。
